Mark tag with no highlight style strips the mark

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"highlight_style\":\"None\"}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>Text with <mark>plain</mark> content.</p>", options)
    println(result)
}
```
